say:1:1621505001:1.text: Settle down, everyone! Lady Meowris will be here soon!
say:1:1621505001:1.source_cn: 安静，安静！喵丽丝大人很快就来了！

say:2:1621505002:1.source_cn: 你是谁？以前没见过你啊，是来听喵丽丝大人演讲的吗？

say:5:1621505004:1.text: Lady Meowris is a legend! She's smart, bold, and dares to dream big! She aspires to become the savior of all animals!

say:6:1621505009:1.text: That said, I'm starting to wonder why Lady Meowris hasn't arrived yet.

say:9:1621505011:1.source_cn: 这只羊的语速很慢，你听懂了所有意思。

say:14:1621505014:1.text: But Lady Meowris is always punctual... We should check on her!
say:14:1621505014:1.source_cn: 但是喵丽丝大人很少迟到啊……不行，我们得去帮她！

say:15:1621505015:1.text: Don't make such a big deal out of it. It's completely normal to run into unexpected <style="highlight">...</style> from time to time.

say:16:1621505016:1.text: I always make sure to comb my fur nicely before going out. On a bad fur day, it takes longer to style.
say:16:1621505016:1.source_cn: 我每次出门都得把耳朵上的毛理顺理顺，打结了就得费点时间。

say:17:1621505017:1.text: Maybe Lady Meowris is having the same problem. She definitely wants to look her best today.
say:17:1621505017:1.source_cn: 今天是喵丽丝大人的重要演讲，可能她和我一样还在纠结造型呢。

say:20:1621505019:1.text: Well, I've heard that a lot, but I don't date sheep, sorry.
say:20:1621505019:1.source_cn: 得了吧，喜欢我的动物多了去了，再说我对羊一点兴趣都没有。

say:23:1621505021:1.text: Haha, the sheep was just agreeing with you! Guess longer ears don't mean better hearing after all!
say:23:1621505021:1.source_cn: 哈哈，人家只是认同你的话，你这自恋狂，长那么长的耳朵还...

say:24:1621505022:1.text: What! How dare you criticize my <style="highlight">...</style>!

say:28:1621505024:1.text: ... See this? It's no easy feat to unite this unruly crowd.
say:28:1621505024:1.source_cn: ……你看到了吗？要把这群乌合之众团结起来可不容易。
say:28:1621505024:1.male: ... See this? It's no easy feat to unite this unruly crowd.

say:35:1621505030:1.text: Meow, I know your nose isn't as sharp as mine, but you should be able to handle it, right?

say:38:1621505035:1.text: Well, off you go. I'm not sure how much longer I can hold things together here.
